newsitem.title: USA: Enron confirms venture with Italy's ENEL.
newsitem.headline: Enron confirms venture with Italy's ENEL.

text.p: Enron Corp confirmed on Tuesday that its Enron Europe Ltd unit would form an electricity generating joint venture with Italian utility ENEL Societa per Azioni (ENEL).
The 50/50 joint venture will own up to 5,000 megawatts of power plants which are currently owned by ENEL and will supply customers in Europe, Houston-based Enron said in a statement.
The joint venture plants will sell electricty to ENEL until it gains a license to sell its power independently.

No details on the costs or the precise composition of the joint venture were given and Enron said that the plants would be a combination of single cycle oil and gas fired power stations, which would be upgraded to combined cycle gas fired plants.
Enron said that it would act as fuel manager for the joint venture and provide risk management services to the venture as the market liberalizes. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
